title: Binary search: first occurrence
requirements: C++17 function lab::binary_search_first(vector<int>, int) returning optional<size_t>; ascending sorted input, first duplicate, empty and missing cases, O(log n).

title: Linear search and comparison counting
requirements: C++17 lab::linear_search(vector<int>, int) returns a struct with optional<size_t> index and size_t comparisons. First occurrence, no input mutation, exact comparisons for empty/missing/early hits. Explain O(n) versus binary search prerequisites.

title: Prefix sums and checked range queries
requirements: C++17 lab::PrefixSums constructed from vector<int>; range_sum(size_t begin,size_t end) returns long long for half-open ranges; empty range allowed, invalid/out-of-bounds ranges throw out_of_range. Store long long sums and document representable-sum precondition.

title: Two pointers for a sorted two-sum problem
requirements: C++17 lab::two_sum_sorted(const vector<int>&, long long) returns optional<pair<size_t,size_t>> with distinct ordered indices. Ascending input, duplicates and negatives, calculate sums in long long, no input mutation; any valid pair accepted, O(n).

title: Validate balanced brackets with a stack
requirements: C++17 lab::balanced_brackets(string_view) returns bool for (), [], {}; ignore other characters, empty valid, reject unmatched/mismatched brackets. Explain stack invariant and O(n) time/space.

title: Lossless run-length encoding
requirements: C++17 lab::encode_runs(string_view) returns vector<pair<char,size_t>>, lab::decode_runs restores string. Treat bytes including null bytes correctly, no delimiter ambiguity, empty input roundtrip. Decode rejects zero-length runs; document memory limits.

title: Insertion sort and loop invariants
requirements: C++17 lab::insertion_sort(vector<int>&) sorts in place without std::sort. Cover empty, sorted, reverse, negatives, duplicates and extremes; compare to std::sort on deterministic generated arrays. Explain prefix invariant and O(n^2) worst-case, O(1) space.

title: Merge two sorted sequences
requirements: C++17 lab::merge_sorted(const vector<int>&, const vector<int>&) returns vector<int> preserving all duplicate values, no input mutation. Empty sides, unequal lengths, negatives, linear time; ascending inputs are a documented precondition.

title: Euclidean greatest common divisor
requirements: C++17 lab::gcd(unsigned long long,unsigned long long), gcd(0,0)=0. Iterative remainder algorithm, no subtraction loop; test zeros, equal/coprime/divisible values, largest unsigned values and compare to std::gcd. Explain termination.

title: Composition with an interchangeable discount policy
requirements: C++17 small checkout example using composition rather than inheritance: integer cents, a configurable discount callable, reject negative prices and discounts outside [0,subtotal], check arithmetic overflow. Test no discount, fixed discount, full discount and invalid cases. Explain ownership, contract and why inheritance is unnecessary.
